def transform(grid):
    # The solid divider separates two binary masks. Keep their overlap.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    div_color = next(c for row in grid for c in set(row) if c not in (0,))
    # Locate the full divider row or column (the line is a single-color separator).
    row_sep = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0,)), None)
    if row_sep is not None:
        a, b = grid[:row_sep], grid[row_sep+1:]
        return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ra, rb)] for ra, rb in zip(a, b)]
    col_sep = next(c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1)
    return [[2 if grid[r][c] != 0 and grid[r][c+col_sep+1] != 0 else 0 for c in range(col_sep)] for r in range(h)]
